GANYU-CRYA_THEORY.description:
Only Cryo and Anemo can react with other elements. Other elements coexist without reacting. Anemo Swirl priority: Cryo, Hydro, Pyro, Electro, Geo.
[gold]Any element + Anemo[/gold] triggers Swirl.
[gold]Cryo + Pyro[/gold] triggers Melt.
[gold]Cryo + Hydro[/gold] triggers Frozen.
[gold]Cryo + Geo[/gold] triggers Crystallize.
[gold]Cryo + Electro[/gold] triggers Superconduct.
Each time an element is applied to an enemy, gain 1 stack of the corresponding elemental Charge.
GANYU-CRYA_THEORY.flavor: Elemental reaction priority follows the order listed above.
GANYU-CRYA_THEORY.title: Cryo Theory
GANYU-ELEMENTAL_HOURGLASS.description: When using a card to apply an element without triggering an elemental reaction, gain the corresponding elemental Charge. Upon reaching certain Charge thresholds, gain powerful buffs.
GANYU-ELEMENTAL_HOURGLASS.flavor: The sand in the hourglass never ceases to flow, just as the power of elements is ever-renewing.
GANYU-ELEMENTAL_HOURGLASS.title: Elemental Hourglass
